# approvalflow

Human approval queue for AI agents. Repo: https://github.com/richardsondx/approvalflow

## Install

npm i approvalflow
Zero runtime dependencies. Node 20+.

## Quickstart

import { createQueue } from "approvalflow";
const queue = createQueue({ dir: "./approvals", hmacSecret: process.env.APPROVALFLOW_SECRET });
const req = await queue.submit({ agent: "support", action: "issue_refund",
  params: { orderId: 1, usd: 500 }, approvers: ["owner"] });
const waiting = req.wait();
await queue.approve(req.id, { approverId: "owner", reason: "verified" });
const d = await waiting; // { approved, approverId, approverIds, decidedAt, reason, signature }
queue.verifySignature(d); // true when untampered and secret matches

## API

- createQueue({ dir, hmacSecret, defaultTtlMs=600000, onExpire="deny"|"escalate", escalateTo?, approveUrlBase?, notifiers? })
- queue.submit({ agent, action, params, approvers, risk?, context?, quorum=1, ttlMs? }) -> PendingRequest { id, status, wait(), summary() }
- req.wait() -> ApprovalDecision | rejects ApprovalDeniedError (has .decision) | ApprovalExpiredError
- queue.approve(id, { approverId, reason? }) — quorum distinct approvers resolve; duplicates ignored
- queue.deny(id, { approverId, reason? }) — immediate deny
- queue.delegate(id, { from, to, reason? }) — chain recorded, delegate added to approvers
- queue.escalate(id, { to, reason? }) — reassign approvers, extend TTL one period
- queue.listPending() -> PendingSummary[]
- queue.getRequest(id) -> full record with history and signed decision
- queue.verifySignature(decision) -> boolean (HMAC-SHA256)
- queue.close() — stop timers

## Behavior

- One JSON file per request under dir; pending requests reload on startup; approvals survive restarts.
- TTL expiry: onExpire "deny" rejects waiters with ApprovalExpiredError; "escalate" reassigns to escalateTo once, then denies on second expiry.
- Every state change appends { ts, requestId, event, actor, detail } to dir/audit.jsonl.
- notifiers: { onEvent(event), webhookUrl } — webhook POSTs Slack-compatible { text, requestId, action, risk, approveUrlHint }, fire-and-forget.
- Use as the human side of callgate's REQUIRE_APPROVAL, or standalone in any agent loop.
